Class AetherisNotebookPanel.QuietSplitUi

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.plaf.ComponentUI
javax.swing.plaf.SplitPaneUI
javax.swing.plaf.basic.BasicSplitPaneUI
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel.QuietSplitUi
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
private static final class AetherisNotebookPanel.QuietSplitUi extends BasicSplitPaneUI
The class QuietSplitUi is the split UI for the cell bar. The shared split UI stays on the other bars. The type builds a AetherisNotebookPanel.QuietDivider. The type clears the split border. A caller installs this UI on the cell-bar split. createDefaultDivider() supplies the painted bar. installDefaults() clears the border and sets the divider size.

    • installDefaults

      protected void installDefaults()
      The method installs the basic split defaults. The method then clears the split border when the split pane exists. The divider size becomes SshClientTheme.DIVIDER_SIZE, which is 11, when the split pane exists. The divider border is cleared when the divider exists.
